condition: Contract type is unknown or ambiguous.
evaluation_logic: unknown -> INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION; ambiguous -> REVIEW; otherwise identification PASS for scoping only.
source_statement: Not a quotation from a Shariah standard. The architecture requires an identified contract type before structure-specific rules run.
interpretation_note: Missing identification is not treated as compliance.

condition: LendingClub predictors or excluded fields are supplied as Shariah evidence.
evaluation_logic: If extra contains frozen credit fields, REVIEW; else PASS this boundary check.
source_statement: Not a Shariah quotation. Frozen LendingClub predictors are credit-risk fields and are not Shariah variables.
interpretation_note: The engine must not silently interpret fico_n, dti_n, purpose, or similar as religious evidence.

condition: An IBI offers or launches a product or service without prior Shariah Board approval.
evaluation_logic: Applies only if institution_class=IBI and contract is an identified Islamic mode. unknown approval -> INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION; false -> NOT_STRUCTURABLE_WITHOUT_REDESIGN; true -> PASS this rule.
document: Shariah Governance Framework for Islamic Banking Institutions (Effective from: January 01, 2025)
clause: All products or services to be offered and/or launched by the IBI shall have prior approval of the SB.
source_statement: The SB shall cause to develop a comprehensive Shariah compliance framework for all areas of operations of the IBI. All products or services to be offered and/or launched by the IBI shall have prior approval of the SB.
interpretation_note: Interpreted as a Pakistani IBI product-governance prerequisite, not as a global fatwa and not as certification of the economic substance of Murabahah or Ijarah.

condition: IBI product programs/structures, process flows, or related agreements lack Shariah Board approval.
evaluation_logic: Same IBI scope as SH-SBP-SGF-002. unknown -> INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION; false -> NOT_STRUCTURABLE_WITHOUT_REDESIGN; true -> PASS this rule.
document: Shariah Governance Framework for Islamic Banking Institutions (Effective from: January 01, 2025)
clause: The SB shall review and approve all the procedure manuals, product programs/structures, process flows, related agreements...
source_statement: The SB shall review and approve all the procedure manuals, product programs/structures, process flows, related agreements, broader parameters pertaining to sales/marketing so that they are in conformity with the rules and principles of Shariah.
interpretation_note: Operationalised as a binary evidence flag. The engine does not inspect the legal drafting of those documents.

condition: IBI Murabaha invoice is not in Bank-Account Client form and lacks the permitted Shariah Advisor exception.
evaluation_logic: IBI+Murabahah only. See evaluator docstring in rules.py.
document: IBD Circular No. 01 of 2012: Invoice of Murabaha Transactions
source_statement: The invoice issued by the supplier shall be in the name of Bank-Account Client e.g. “1st Islamic Bank – ABC Company”. In case where obtaining invoice in the name of IBI is not possible, the invoice in the name of client may also be acceptable, subject to specific approval of the Shariah Advisor, for all such transactions.
interpretation_note: Applies only to Pakistani IBI Murabaha. Not applied to Ijarah or LendingClub purpose codes.

condition: No formal Murabaha invoice and alternative purchase documents and/or Shariah Advisor approval are missing.
document: IBD Circular No. 01 of 2012: Invoice of Murabaha Transactions
source_statement: In transaction where obtaining formal invoice either in the name of bank or the client is not possible, then the document or combination of documents like Truck Receipts, Delivery Note, Goods Received Notes, Physical Inspection Report, Kachi Parchi, Inward Gate Pass etc having particulars (i.e. names of buyer & seller, date of purchase/delivery, description of goods, quantity and purchase amount etc.) may be accepted in lieu of invoice with the approval of Shariah Advisor.
interpretation_note: The listed document types are examples from the circular; the engine only tests presence of alternative documents plus Advisor approval.

condition: IBI Murabaha payment is not to the supplier or escrow, and the agent exception is not documented.
evaluation_logic: supplier/escrow PASS; agent needs approval+reasons; customer NOT_STRUCTURABLE_WITHOUT_REDESIGN; unknown INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.
document: IBD Circular No. 01 of 2012: Invoice of Murabaha Transactions
source_statement: The payment for Murabaha transactions shall either be made directly to supplier or credited in an escrow account by the IBIs. However, in cases where direct payment to supplier is not possible due to genuine reasons, the payment to the supplier may be made through the agent subject to explicitly recording the reasons and approval of process flow etc of all such transactions by the Shariah Advisor.
interpretation_note: Payment to the customer is treated as outside the permitted channels in the circular text. This is a Pakistani IBI Murabaha operational mapping, not an AAOIFI SS (8) clause.

condition: A person claims a security is Shariah compliant without a Commission certificate.
evaluation_logic: Skipped for IBIs (SGR excludes SBP banks). If no claim, skip. Unknown certificate -> INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION; false -> NOT_STRUCTURABLE_WITHOUT_REDESIGN; true -> PASS this rule.
authority: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
clause: No security shall be called a Shariah compliant security unless a Shariah compliance certificate has been granted by the Commission under these regulations.
page: printed page 5 of the hosted SRO PDF
source_statement: No security shall be called a Shariah compliant security unless a Shariah compliance certificate has been granted by the Commission under these regulations.
interpretation_note: Applies only when a Shariah-compliant-security claim is made under SECP's company/security regime. Does not classify LendingClub loans.

evaluation_logic: Always INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION for Murabahah because official SS (8) clauses were not retrieved.
source_statement: AAOIFI publishes a standard titled SS (8) Murabahah. The official page does not provide retrievable clause text in this environment (copyright / password-protected viewer).
interpretation_note: This gate refuses to invent SS (8) possession, agency, or riba clauses. It is not an AAOIFI ruling.

condition: Contract is identified as Ijarah or Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek.
evaluation_logic: Always INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION for Ijarah identifications because official SS (9) clauses were not retrieved.
document: SS (9) Ijarah and Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek (identity page)
source_statement: AAOIFI publishes a standard titled SS (9) Ijarah and Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek. Official clause text was not retrieved.
interpretation_note: This gate refuses to invent SS (9) lessor-ownership or IMBT transfer clauses.
